The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
A language model learns to predict the next token in a sequence.
A tokenizer converts text into a sequence of integer identifiers.
Byte-level byte pair encoding keeps every input representable.
Training a tokenizer is deterministic when the corpus order is fixed.
Reserved tokens must keep their identifiers for the lifetime of the model.
Padding tokens are excluded from the loss through an explicit mask.
Rotary position embedding rotates query and value channels before attention.
The feed-forward network uses a gated linear unit with a SiLU activation.
Gradient clipping by global norm keeps early optimizer steps stable.
Checkpoint publication is atomic: write, validate, then rename.
Resuming a run must restore the optimizer, the scheduler and the global step.
A cached decode must agree with an uncached decode within dtype tolerance.
Perplexity is only meaningful when the evaluation corpus matches the tokenizer.
Every prepared shard records the tokenizer identity it was built with.
Numerical health metrics include the gradient norm and the loss scale.
Sequence packing minimises padding while preserving document boundaries.
Deduplication happens before the evaluation split to reduce contamination.
The reference backend is deterministic and free of just-in-time compilation.
Profiling identifies the bottleneck before any kernel is rewritten.
Zero means zero, one means one, and the rest is arithmetic.

The tokenizer must not corrupt combining marks or non-Latin scripts.
An empty input is defined and produces an empty token sequence.
Long inputs are truncated only when the caller explicitly asks for it.
A vocabulary that cannot be filled is a data problem, not a tuning problem.
The reserved identifiers are bos, eos, pad and unk in that order.
Vocabulary size must equal the model configuration it was trained for.
Encode and decode must round-trip arbitrary valid UTF-8 text.
Special token identifiers never change after the model has been trained.
Every artifact is identified by a hash recorded in the run manifest.
The dataset manifest records source, licence and acquisition date.
Sequences are consumed in iteration order, so determinism is the caller's duty.
The trainer places reserved tokens at the head of the vocabulary.
A mismatch between artifact and configuration fails fast rather than silently.
